items.subject: New jobs similar to Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions at Spotify
items.summary: LinkedIn recommends London product-management roles, including subscription products at Nothing, audiobooks at Spotify, B2B SaaS at Kato and inbox products at Proton.
items.action: Review the Nothing and Spotify roles first, then compare the other roles’ requirements, salaries, closing dates and commutes before deciding whether to apply.
items.decisionNeeded: Decide whether any recommended product-management role is worth applying for.
